description: This file declares interfaces for a GStreamer dispatcher thread and its factory within the Rialto media server component. It defines abstract classes with virtual methods for creating and managing dispatcher thread instances, including reference management and thread safety considerations.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThreadFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory interface for creating IGstDispatcherThread instances.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThread
classes.description: Interface representing a dispatcher thread for GStreamer operations.

methods.name: createGstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Creates a new IGstDispatcherThread instance with specified client and pipeline.
